risks.reasoning: For the three months ended March 31, 2022, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash used in operating activities of RMB385,214 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at period end of RMB4,277,140 thousand. Monthly operating cash burn is approximately RMB128,405 thousand and cash runway is approximately 33.31 months, above the 12-month trigger.

The accountants' report shows losses of RMB901,131 thousand, RMB1,100,093 thousand, RMB2,845,773 thousand, RMB397,235 thousand and RMB1,042,203 thousand for 2019, 2020, 2021, 3M2021 and 3M2022 respectively. Five comparable loss periods meet the frozen high threshold.

Revenue increased from RMB278,047 thousand in 3M2021 to RMB1,991,837 thousand in 3M2022, an increase of approximately 616.37%. The latest comparable growth is positive and does not trigger the frozen negative-growth thresholds.

For 3M2022, the largest customer accounted for approximately 1.7% and the five largest customers accounted for approximately 6.1% of revenue. Both ratios remain below the frozen medium thresholds of 30% and 60%.

For 3M2022, the largest supplier accounted for approximately 16.2% and the five largest suppliers accounted for approximately 35.4% of cost of sales. The top-five ratio reaches the frozen medium threshold of 30%, triggering a medium concentration risk.

The Pre-IPO Investors had been granted special rights including redemption rights. All special rights have ceased to be effective and been discontinued as of the Latest Practicable Date, and the financial instruments with preferred rights at amortized cost were derecognized in December 2020. No restoration mechanism is disclosed.

The formal Legal Proceedings and Compliance section states that during the Track Record Period and up to the Latest Practicable Date there were no legal proceedings pending or threatened against the Group or its Directors that could, individually or in aggregate, have a material adverse effect, and that the PRC Legal Advisor confirmed material compliance. No material pending matter was identified.

The Group is an established pure-play smart EV manufacturer with revenue from sales of vehicles and parts, automotive regulatory credits and services throughout the Track Record Period. Its core EV products are fully commercialized and delivered to customers.
